subject.title: refactor(mac): make app node a CLI capability superset

question: Is the existing installer coverage and fresh signed-app proof sufficient for the new remote-mode CLI prerequisite, or should direct remote-upgrade proof be required before landing?
rationale: The implementation direction and patch are sound, but every remote Mac node now depends on a matching private CLI worker and the PR carries a protected maintainer signal.

options.title: Require remote-upgrade proof
options.body: Demonstrate an existing remote-mode app repairing a missing or old CLI, reconnecting as one superset node, and not starting a local Gateway.

options.title: Accept current evidence
options.body: Land after exact-head CI based on the compatibility classification tests and signed fresh-path live run already documented.

recommendation.title: Require remote-upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Demonstrate an existing remote-mode app repairing a missing or old CLI, reconnecting as one superset node, and not starting a local Gateway.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history spans the Mac app node, installer, execution boundary, and node-host runtime involved in this decision.
